data.narrative:
Unseenlabs is a Series C-stage space and aerospace company that has raised €112.5M to date. The valuation assessment draws from a comparable universe of 3 same-sector, same-stage private companies (Sierra Space, Varda Space Industries, Skyryse) with valuations ranging from $1.1B to $8.0B, supplemented by reference to 5 public space and aerospace peers trading at a median P/S of 23.9x.

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. The 3 private comparables yield a median valuation of $1.5B, with Sierra Space at the high end ($8.0B) and Skyryse at the low end ($1.1B). This method directly reflects stage and sector alignment. Public-comp anchoring using P/S multiples cannot be applied without disclosed revenue data, which private companies typically do not publish. Accordingly, the analysis rests on the single peer-median result rather than a multi-method triangulation.

The supported valuation range is $1.3B to $1.7B, centered on a median of $1.5B. The material uncertainty reflects the wide dispersion within the peer set—the $8.0B valuation for Sierra Space creates significant upside volatility relative to the median. This spread underscores the stage-specific nature of late-private aerospace valuations, where heterogeneous market positions and funding dynamics drive wide variation. Revenue visibility and customer concentration remain key determinants of where Unseenlabs maps within this range.
